snippet.title: Borderline - Life On The Line - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Download for free: www.tabtale.com/app/borderline/

Attention skydivers, race car drivers and crazy storm chasers: THIS IS THE GAME FOR YOU!!! How fast can you react? How long can you stay in the line? Try this all new extreme & fast-paced arcade game!

Borderline was featured as “Best New Apps” in 120+ countries both in iPhone and iPad
